title: A RAID PICKED UP FROM THE HOST DOES NOT REPLAY ITS EVENTS
why: His ruling: the remaining player picks up the raid when the host is gone. Player 2's window never marked the host's fuel fires, raid events or the RUN GOALS line as done, because the host ran them. At the takeover the raid stops being shared, so his window planned them fresh with nothing marked: every fuel fire and raid event the host had already run came back at once, and RUN GOALS could be said again. Proven in a staged pair in one window. Seed 9071, host to 440 s: after the takeover both fuel fires said FUEL FIRE again and the bounty the host ran at 199 s launched again. Seed 9071, takeover at 195 s with player 2 far from the drop: his own fire plan put the second fire at 204 s in a new place, so a fire the host never planned lit. Seed 5008, takeover at 365 s with the convoy live and the bounty held behind it: the convoy launched again. Now, at the takeover, the fuel fire plan is drawn from the party drop point (the same plan the host drew) and fires already due are marked done, the events the host already launched (its event count, which player 2 has) are marked done so a held one still comes once, and the goals are marked as already told.
now: When your host leaves and you pick up the raid, the fuel fires and raid events that already happened no longer start over.
